summary: MDJM LTD files a Form 6-K reporting the adoption of the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan and the immediate issuance of 200,000 Class B ordinary shares to CEO and Chairman Siping Xu for past services. As a result, Mr. Xu controls approximately 89.58% of aggregate voting power. This is a routine equity incentive grant and plan adoption, not a special-situation event such as a change of control, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing discloses no transaction with third parties or structural change beyond insider ownership increase. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock applies. What to watch: potential future dilution or governance shifts, but no arbitrage angle.
